note: reflect v2 开闸前 T0 的 rig 题集(设计规格 2026-09-08 §5)。语料是公开 LLM 论文,题面本身不含任何私有数据;gold 只对 A 语料保留,供后续 §9.2 的真实决策 A/B 使用,T0 本身只用题号(key)。key 里不许出现半角冒号——它是 client_request_id 的字段分隔符。

A.note: arXiv 2502.05171(递归深度语言模型)。PDF 不在磁盘,rig 用 --source-db-url 从主库的 source_elements 只读重建 markdown 后上传;主库 notebook id 由 --source-notebook 显式传入,刻意不落进仓库。

B.note: 6 篇公开论文。前两个文件是同一篇 DeepSeek-V2 的两次不同解析(140KB / 86KB),刻意保留——B-q07「同标题/同内容」问的就是它们。

ask.zh: 当前notebook的文章说明了什么？
ask.en: What does the paper in this notebook say?

ask.zh: 这篇论文的核心贡献是什么？
ask.en: What is the main contribution of this paper?

ask.zh: 什么是递归深度语言模型？
ask.en: What is a recurrent-depth language model?

ask.zh: 为什么要训练带循环深度的模型？
ask.en: Why train models with recurrent depth?

ask.zh: 模型的宏观架构是怎样的，prelude、循环块和 coda 各做什么？
ask.en: What is the macroscopic design: what do the prelude, recurrent block and coda do?

ask.zh: 循环块的微观设计用了什么归一化和注意力机制？
ask.en: What normalization and attention are used in the microscopic design of the recurrent block?

ask.zh: 训练目标是怎么定义的，循环次数如何采样？
ask.en: How is the training objective defined and how is the number of recurrences sampled?

ask.zh: 模型训练用了多少参数和多少 token？
ask.en: How many parameters and how many tokens were used in training?

ask.zh: 训练用了什么硬件，算力是怎么安排的？
ask.en: What hardware and compute setup was used for training?

ask.zh: 归一化和初始化在大规模训练下为什么重要？
ask.en: Why do norms and initializations matter at scale?

ask.zh: 在标准基准上的结果如何，和 OLMo 相比怎么样？
ask.en: How does the model perform on standard benchmarks compared with OLMo?

ask.zh: 数学和代码基准上的表现如何？
ask.en: How does it perform on math and coding benchmarks?

ask.zh: 循环在哪些任务上帮助最大？
ask.en: Where does recurrence help most?

ask.zh: 权重平均带来了什么提升？
ask.en: What improvement does weight averaging bring?

ask.zh: 测试时如何做零样本自适应计算？
ask.en: How does zero-shot adaptive compute at test time work?

ask.zh: KV 缓存共享是怎么做到的？
ask.en: How is zero-shot KV-cache sharing achieved?

ask.zh: 连续思维链是什么意思？
ask.en: What is zero-shot continuous chain-of-thought?

ask.zh: 自推测解码是怎么实现的？
ask.en: How is self-speculative decoding implemented?

ask.zh: 大规模下涌现了哪些机制，隐空间轨迹长什么样？
ask.en: What mechanisms emerge at scale and what do the latent-space trajectories look like?

ask.zh: 相关工作里和哪些方法做了对比？
ask.en: Which related approaches are discussed in the related work?

ask.zh: 论文提出的未来工作有哪些？
ask.en: What future work does the paper propose?

ask.zh: 预训练数据是怎么构成的？
ask.en: How is the pretraining data composed?

ask.zh: 这个模型有哪些缺点或局限？
ask.en: What are the limitations of this model?

ask.zh: GSM8K 上 r=1 和 r=32 的得分分别是多少？
ask.en: What are the GSM8K scores at r=1 versus r=32?

ask.zh: 这个笔记本里都有哪些文章?请按标题逐一列出。
ask.en: List every paper in this notebook, one by one, by title.

ask.zh: 这些来源里一共有多少张表格、多少个公式?分别出自哪几篇?
ask.en: How many tables and how many formulas are there across these sources, and which paper does each come from?

ask.zh: DeepSeek-V2 的 MLA 与 KIVI 的 KV 量化,在降低 KV 缓存开销上的思路有什么不同?
ask.en: How do DeepSeek-V2's MLA and KIVI's KV quantization differ in how they reduce KV cache cost?

ask.zh: ForesightKV 与 KIVI 在压缩或驱逐 KV 缓存时各自的判据是什么?哪一个需要额外训练?
ask.en: What criteria do ForesightKV and KIVI each use to compress or evict the KV cache, and which one needs extra training?

ask.zh: Jamba 公布的注意力层与 Mamba 层配比默认是多少?在什么条件下会改这个比例?
ask.en: What is Jamba's published default ratio of attention layers to Mamba layers, and under what conditions is that ratio changed?

ask.zh: KIVI 默认把 key 和 value 各量化到多少 bit?沿哪个维度分组,默认组大小是多少?
ask.en: By default, to how many bits does KIVI quantize keys and values, along which axis does it group, and what is the default group size?

ask.zh: 这个笔记本里有没有内容重复的来源?如果有,它们之间的差别在哪里?
ask.en: Does this notebook contain duplicate sources? If so, how do they differ from each other?

ask.zh: 这些论文里关于「思维链蒸馏」的实验结果是怎样的?
ask.en: What are the chain-of-thought distillation results reported in these papers?

ask.zh: 只看 Qwen-VL 和 DeepSeek-V2 这两篇,它们各自是怎么处理图像输入的?
ask.en: Looking only at Qwen-VL and DeepSeek-V2, how does each of them handle image input?

ask.zh: 把这个笔记本里所有论文在降低推理开销上的做法做一次完整综述,逐篇给出方法、代价与适用条件。
ask.en: Write a complete survey of what every paper in this notebook does to reduce inference cost, giving the method, its cost and its applicable conditions for each.

report.question: 这批论文在降低 KV 缓存开销上有哪几条技术路线?各自的取舍是什么?
混合架构(注意力 + 状态空间)在这批论文里的动机、做法与已报告的收益分别是什么?
以这批论文为依据,综述大模型推理成本的来源与现有缓解手段,并指出彼此矛盾或尚未验证的结论。
多模态模型与纯文本模型在这批论文里的评测口径有何不同?哪些比较是不能直接对齐的?

report_depth_note: 报告侧的旋钮是 reports.depth(每节反思步上限,1..16),不是 Ask 的 retrieval_effort;profile 只是 standard/deep 两档的人读标签。
